title: VibraExpression
description: Surrogate schema: a Vibra expression is a YAML scalar, sequence, or mapping; this schema intentionally permits any JSON-safe value. Tooling narrows by context.

oneOf.description: Includes compile-time {$embed: path} / {$embed: {path, format}} expressions and deterministic {$template: {path, with}} text rendering. Embed formats: auto, text, binary, yaml, json, toml, xml.
